claude_code_manual: claude mcp add --scope user home-assistant -e HOMEASSISTANT_URL=http://homeassistant.local:8123 -e HOMEASSISTANT_TOKEN=${HOMEASSISTANT_TOKEN} -- uvx ha-mcp@latest
official_alternative: Home Assistant built-in 'Model Context Protocol Server' integration: remote connector URL https://<your-ha-external-url>/api/mcp (OAuth). Works on claude.ai and phone if HA is reachable (e.g. Nabu Casa, paid).
